# EU DPP Provider — Complete Architectural & Compliance Specification

## 1. Executive Summary
EU DPP Provider (https://eudppprovider.com) provides enterprise-grade compliance software and sovereign data vault infrastructure for manufacturers, pack assemblers, and automotive OEMs subject to the European Union's Battery Regulation (Regulation EU 2023/1542) and Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR, Regulation EU 2024/1781).

## 2. Regulatory Framework & Deadlines
- **Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (Articles 77 & 78)**: Mandates that all EV batteries, LMT batteries (≤25kg), and industrial batteries (>2kWh) placed on the EU market must carry an electronic Battery Passport accessible via a permanent GS1 Digital Link 2D QR code.
- **Enforcement Timeline**: Mandatory from February 18, 2027.
- **DG GROW Central Registry**: Unique Product Identifiers (UPI) and conformity declarations must be registered with the European Commission's Central DPP Registry with eIDAS 2.0 digital seals (QSeal/PAdES Baseline).
- **ESPR Article 11**: Digital Product Passport backup provider and data persistence mandates requiring 10-year active lifecycle data availability even if an enterprise ceases operation.

## 3. The 3-Layer Data Architecture
1. **Upstream Ingestion Layer**: Read-only integration with factory MES, ERP (SAP/Oracle/Siemens), PLM, and battery testing systems (BMS). Aligns mandatory EU 70+ data points with domestic battery traceability codes.
2. **Cleanroom & Zero-Knowledge Verification Layer**: In-country computation with strict whitelist export. Proprietary chemical formulations and commercial BOM pricing are mathematically verified via Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP) without transmitting raw trade secrets across borders.
3. **European Sovereign Storage & Public Resolver**: Hosted in ISO/IEC 27001 certified data centers in Frankfurt am Main and Munich. Delivers sub-50ms global DNS resolution for customs officers, test laboratories, and consumers.

## 4. Product Matrix & Capabilities
- **EV Battery Passport**: Vehicle VIN to battery pack dynamic pairing, PEFCR Carbon Footprint Declarations (CFD), supply chain due diligence tracking.
- **LMT & E-Bike Battery Passport (≤25kg)**: High-density compact laser-marked QR codes for light mobility packs and swappable e-bike battery enclosures.
- **Industrial & Storage BESS (>2kWh)**: Modular rack-to-container hierarchy, State of Health (SOH) telemetry aggregation, second-life repurposing management.
- **Carbon Footprint Engine (PCF)**: Scope 1, 2, and 3 lifecycle emissions calculation engine compliant with European Commission PEFCR guidelines.
- **GS1 Digital Link 2D Serializer**: ISO/IEC 15459 compliant laser-marking specifications and context-aware redirection logic.

## 5. Commercial Models
- **Enterprise DPP Software Suite**: Perpetual license or annual subscription for on-premise / private cloud hosting. Includes complete source access, zero scan fees, and pre-built MES connectors.
- **10-Year Managed Sovereign Data Vault**: Turnkey data hosting in Frankfurt. Includes 99.9% uptime SLA, 30-day regulatory updates, and official DG GROW registry filing support.
